system.description:
This is another one-person wearable vehicle consisting of V-shaped hard wing of advanced materials with multiple jet or rocket engines, worn along with a heat-proof suit. The wingpack is essentially a glider. It must take off from the air, like a parachutist, and after a 20-minute flight time, the user must parachute, as a safe powered landing isn’t possible. Attacks on the wingpack also damage its wearer and force them to make a TN 13 Dexterity (Piloting) test to retain control or fall. The first test does not require an action, but subsequent tests after a failure each require a minor action.

Handling -2; velocity Very Fast/*; hull 0; Resources TN 16.
